verdict.rationale: DPMA's own pages say the core transaction, filing an IP application, can be done online. DPMAdirektWeb handles trade mark and design applications without a signature card, DPMAdirektPro handles patent and other IP applications with a signature card, and the e-filing page presents electronic filing as an alternative to paper, mail or fax. missing for 10: evidence that fees can be paid online; patent e-filing needs a signature card and downloaded desktop software; DPMAdirektWeb is available in German only; no independent or hands-on confirmation that a filing was completed end-to-end.
